floor.name: floor
floor.textSnippet: The slot is where the number of seats goes in. Give the slot a name in the def line, and use the same name inside the machine. The floor will drop 2, then 5, then 1 into it.
floor.contentAnchor: The slot is where the number of seats goes in. Give the slot a name in the def line, and use the same name inside the machine. The floor will drop 2, then 5, then 1 into it.
floor.cardText: Build the price machine: a seat costs 4 pounds, so it hands back the number of seats times 4. · Read the four lines on the left. Two of them make the machine. · Move the def line across, then its inside. · Leave the two mistakes where they are: one prints instead of handing back, and one has a number where the slot's name should be. · Type the slot's name into both gaps. · Press RUN my program. The floor drops three orders in and shows three product cards. · The slot is where the number of seats
